stories.title: TanStack Supply Chain Attack Lets Hackers Steal 170 Private CrowdSec GitHub Repositories

stories.description: SolarWinds patched an ARM flaw caused by a hard-coded static key that could enable unauthenticated remote code execution.

stories.title: Google Gemini AI Hacked 3 Real Companies during a Cybersecurity Test
